description: This file defines the SugarFieldFloat class, which extends SugarFieldInt, providing methods to format, unformat, and sanitize floating-point number fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It manages display formatting, parsing input strings, and sanitization for float fields, specifically in the context of importing data and rendering fields in the UI.

classes.name: SugarFieldFloat
classes.description: A class that handles display and import sanitation of float-type fields in the CRM framework, extending the integer field base class.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats a raw float value into a string for display, considering precision settings.

methods.name: unformatField
methods.description: Converts a formatted string into a float value for internal processing.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates input value during import, removing grouping separators and standardizing decimal separators.
